test_TargetMetricTracker_max: test TargetMetricTracker with direction MAX to check if sliding window average exceeds target accuracy
test_TargetMetricTracker_min: test TargetMetricTracker with direction MIN to check if sliding window average drops below target loss
create_TargetMetricTracker_SMA: create a TargetMetricTracker using SMA average type to track evaluation metrics over a sliding window
create_TargetMetricTracker_EMA: create a TargetMetricTracker using EMA average type to track evaluation metrics over a sliding window
run_update_and_check_target: run update_and_check_target on a TargetMetricTracker to feed in new metric values and check if target is reached
